an4.35:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
an4.35:1.2: athakho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.35:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.35:2.1: catūhi kho mayaṃ bho gotama dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpema
an4.35:2.3: idha bho gotama bahussuto hoti tassa tasseva sutajātassa
an4.35:2.4: tassa tasseva kho pana bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa atthoti
an4.35:2.5: satimā kho pana hoti cirakataṃpi cirabhāsitaṃpi saritā anussaritā
an4.35:2.6: yāni kho pana tāni gahaṭṭhakāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ
an4.35:2.7: imehi kho mayaṃ bho gotama catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpema
an4.35:2.8: sace me bho gotama anumoditabbaṃ anumodatu me bhavaṃ gotamo
an4.35:2.9: sace pana me bho gotama paṭikkositabbaṃ paṭikkosatu me bhavaṃ gotamoti.
an4.35:3.1: neva kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa anumodāmi nappaṭikkosāmi
an4.35:3.2: catūhi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemi
an4.35:3.4: idha brāhmaṇa bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya
an4.35:3.5: bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā
an4.35:3.6: so yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṃkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṃkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi
an4.35:3.7: yaṃ saṃkappaṃ ākaṃkhati saṃkappetuṃ taṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappeti yaṃ saṃkappaṃ nākaṃkhati saṃkappetuṃ na taṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappeti
an4.35:3.9: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an4.35:3.10: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an4.35:3.11: neva kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa anumodāmi nappaṭikkosāmi
an4.35:3.12: imehi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemīti.
an4.35:4.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama abbhutaṃ bho gotama
an4.35:4.3: imehi ca pana catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dhāremi
an4.35:4.5: bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā
an4.35:4.6: bhavañhi gotamo yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṃkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṃkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi yaṃ saṃkappaṃ ākaṃkhati saṃkappetuṃ taṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappeti yaṃ saṃkappaṃ nākaṃkhati saṃkappetuṃ na taṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappeti
an4.35:4.8: bhavañhi gotamo catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an4.35:4.9: bhavañhi gotamo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an4.35:5.1: addhā kho te brāhmaṇa āsajja upanīyavācā bhāsitā
an4.35:5.4: bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā
an4.35:5.5: ahañhi brāhmaṇa yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṃkhāmi vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṃkhāmi vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi yaṃ saṃkappaṃ ākaṃkhāmi saṃkappetuṃ taṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappemi yaṃ saṃkappaṃ nākaṃkhāmi saṃkappetuṃ na taṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappemi
an4.35:5.7: ahañhi brāhmaṇa catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an4.35:5.8: ahañhi brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti.
